description: Pattern: the person deletes a conversation (c28; owner decisions L2 c17/c18). A SAVED engine thread with two turns (it reads notes.txt twice), then the window's own request, POST /chat/conversation/forget { clientThreadId }, handled by the product's route handler with the same forgetters the bridge registers. Proved by code, each from facts read on both sides of the delete: routeAccepted; storeRowsGone (the chat store has no conversation, no messages, no listing, no local message ids, and the route reports the rows it deleted); engineGone (thread/resume of the engine thread fails and every thread of the room reports state deleted); pendingReadingsWithdrawn (a pending reading heard in this conversation is gone, the module count equals it); conversationMemoryGone (pages in this conversation's temporary scope and the readings on them); otherMemoryKept (another conversation's page and its pending reading, a personal page and its accepted reading are untouched); pointerMarked (a text-less page of another scope that pointed at this conversation's first message stays as a pointer marked sourceDeleted). The memory is SEEDED synthetic data written into the check's own isolated store (what the models would write is not deterministic): what is proven is the deletion. Needs --persisted-with-cleanup; no Decision model needed. Expectations by code.
